id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_060.pack|cs_: Well now, you two gentlemen! Smooth, spiky hair, all perfectly styled. Such fine looks!
With looks like that, it'd be a waste to just watch! Please, enter the Mighty Man Contest!
Hey, old man. We don't have time for any contest...
...Heh. A fugitive hides in a crowd. I planned to use this contest to flush you out, but it seems I needn't have bothered.
To think you'd walk right into the contest grounds, bold as brass.
That armor of his... Don't tell me...
I am Jasper, strategist and right hand to the King of Heliodor! And...
This is the Darkspawn, {var:1}! The bringer of calamity who destroyed the kingdom of Dundrasil!
That is the Darkspawn, {var:1}! The bringer of calamity who destroyed the kingdom of Dundrasil!
Come now, accursed Darkspawn {var:1}! Surrender quietly into my hands!
You've got to be kidding me...
id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_070.pack|cs_: Damn...! No matter how many we beat, there's no end to them!
Stop this pointless struggle. Now, quietly...
Anyone who picks on my darling {var:1} gets punished!
What are those people?! What are the guards doing?!
Come on, come on! Move aside, or you'll get burned!
...Tch. So they have allies. Seize them at once!
Quickly, {var:1}, Master Erik. This way, please!
Forget about me! {var:1}, at least you have to get away!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_080.pack|cs_: We're safe now. Everyone's unhurt, thank goodness.
But Master Erik was captured... What could they be doing to him now...
It's all right, Serena darling. Erik isn't someone who gets done in so easily.
...Still, I don't understand any of this. The Darkspawn {var:1} is meant to defeat the Dark One? What does that mean?
...{var:1} was branded a bringer of calamity by Heliodor, and has been hunted ever since.
I meant to tell you properly, Sylvando, in time... I'm sorry for dragging you into this.
Oh, don't worry about that. I knew from the very start that {var:1} isn't a bad kid.
More importantly, this time we make the first move.
The town is full of soldiers. But if we move through the buildings, we can avoid pointless fights.
First, let's scout Erik from the big bridge in the middle of town! We can reach it over the rooftops from the inn!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_085.pack|cs_: ...I wonder if Erik is all right. We should hurry and rescue him.
